title: Scaffold Next.js app and wire up verification
outcome: A Next.js 16 (App Router) + TypeScript app exists in this repository, joined to the js/ pnpm workspace, with working dev/build/lint/typecheck/test scripts (vitest for tests) and scripts/verify-task.sh running all of them. The home page can be a placeholder -- SimpleFin integration is out of scope for this task.
acceptance: package.json exists with a name, and scripts for dev, build, lint, typecheck, test (vitest), and verify (verify runs lint + typecheck + test + build in sequence, non-interactively, exiting non-zero on any failure).
TypeScript is configured in strict mode.
The app uses the App Router (app/ directory), matching js/ember-finance's layout conventions where reasonable.
No styling framework is added -- plain CSS only (a single globals.css is sufficient for this task).

pnpm-lock.yaml exists and is committed for this repo. Do not edit anything outside this repository's own directory (in particular, never touch ../pnpm-workspace.yaml -- the maintainer owns that file).
scripts/verify-task.sh is updated to run `pnpm run verify` (or the equivalent lint+typecheck+test+build sequence) instead of the placeholder stub, and exits non-zero on failure.
A minimal home page (app/page.tsx or equivalent) renders without error -- content can be a placeholder heading, no SimpleFin calls yet.
At least one vitest test exists and passes (even a trivial smoke test), to prove the test runner is wired up correctly.
The repository's required verification command (./scripts/verify-task.sh) passes.
No SimpleFin code or environment variable handling is added in this task -- that is m1-002's scope.
